route.name: Rotterdam (Coolhaven) - Kinderdijk - Schoonhoven - Gouda 60 km ENG 2024 (copy)

course_points.n: Start of ride; water on your left
Bear right onto Pieter de Hoochbrug to junction 14
Continue straight; do not follow junction network
Continue straight onto Maasboulevard to junction 67
Turn left; cross road to junction 58
Turn right to ferry to junction 61
Turn left onto Lekweg to junction 03
At roundabout take exit 2 to junction 13
Right and directly left to junction 12
At roundabout take exit 2 to junction 34
Continue straight to mooring; turn right to city center

points_of_interest.description: can eat lunch outside when ordering drinks

points_of_interest.name: Café Fausto Schoonhoven
points_of_interest.description: cycling themed coffee bar, best espresso in town
